status: ABSENT: production builds refuse until every null field below is filled from the approved release

fields.logOrigin: Approved exact HTTPS origin of the production log, as recorded in the published trust asset.
fields.trustAssetSha256: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the published canonical next-trust/production.json bytes. The SDK release embeds that asset; this app only checks that the installed SDK embedded exactly this digest.
fields.sdkPin: File name in vendor/ of the JSON pin for the production-packaged SDK archive produced by the SDK release pipeline. package.json must depend on the archive that pin names.
